title: Checkout handoff
idea: Checkout handoff: Order identity and amount remain visible while a payment-provider handoff and return state are explained.
audience: People who need to complete checkout within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: Payment occurs in a trusted external or embedded provider flow.
avoidWhen: The page can grant entitlements from frontend claims.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic transaction layout through its complete checkout priority and explicit commitment contract: Only verified backend fulfillment may grant purchased access.
navigation: Checkout handoff keeps the current complete checkout context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Order identity and amount remain visible while a payment-provider handoff and return state are explained.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to complete checkout; payment occurs in a trusted external or embedded provider flow.
composition.priority: Only verified backend fulfillment may grant purchased access.

imagery.role: Support the actual complete checkout context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Preserve the order review on navigation and handle return without duplicate submission.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the checkout handoff structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no complete checkout content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Only verified backend fulfillment may grant purchased access.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized complete checkout content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Only verified backend fulfillment may grant purchased access.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active complete checkout context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
